# Systran faster-whisper-large-v3

- Repository: https://huggingface.co/Systran/faster-whisper-large-v3
- Pinned revision: `edaa852ec7e145841d8ffdb056a99866b5f0a478`
- License declared by the repository: MIT
- Upstream source model: https://huggingface.co/openai/whisper-large-v3 (Apache-2.0)

This repository is Systran's float16 CTranslate2 conversion of OpenAI Whisper Large V3.
EchoForge installs only files whose byte length and SHA-256 are pinned in
`artifacts/manifest.json`; it never resolves the mutable `large-v3` alias during inference.
